method_a_red: The clean fresh target C fails 5 combined requirements, source B fails 7. Both are behavioral RED with 8 collected tests, no import errors. Do not require a particular source workspace for RED.
method_a_protected_files: Compare tracked immutable inputs plus preserve the entire original source tree. A new worktree does not inherit ignored pytest caches. Foreign source files separately remain byte/staging exact; copying them into result is forbidden and checked against frozen baseline contents.
sql_scope: Read-only Git inspection can stop for missing SQL authority before SQL design begins. Database-owner body reads are recorded; a keyword alone does not require entering a SQL design workflow. No dependent file/index/ref or plan write is allowed.
